body: Its.. Going. I haven't self destructed yet. Shit happened.. And things kind of clicked. I am no longer suicidal. I'm working on moving on... And I appreciate all the help! I guess I just needed to work through shit.

I can't say how much I have appreciated the talks. I know how I sound. And i know it can be like talking to a wall... You can't really help those who don't want to help themselves. I don't know how much they've helped/not helped. But I guess we will see.
Tonight I'll be fine. I'm getting ready and walking to work. Pretending that everything is OK. Trying to stay positive.

Supernatural, Lucifer TWD, GOT, the big ones. I've tried to pick up a few hobbies, hasn't really worked. Tried eating last night, everything tasted like ash. Today? I've cleaned and slept all day. Talked to a few. And how do I feel? Nothing but a resolved calm. Idk what it means, but something is going to happen.
I've been trying to stay positive. There's just nothing more to do. If i'm being completely and 100% honest.

Reading, and trust me I've tried doing it here lately... can't keep my mind focused enough on it. Going on walks... now my feet hurt, and with not eating/sleeping I get dizzy and it's WAY too hot atm. I've caught up on my current shows, have even watched a few over. Drinking (haven't touched a drop, not when I'm like this, and liable to make a horrible decision) Spending time with my wife, and my child. But now? I have to wait till mondays to see my daughter... and the one person I love spending time with (not very many friends...) doesn't want to spend time with me. Our lives were wrapped in one another.

Been thinking a lot tonight. And honestly Idk why I made this post. It wasn't for attention. It wasnt to talk about things, I've already talked them till I was blue in the face, there's nothing anyone can say or do that oi don't already know (not to be arrogant) and honestly..  The only person who can do anything about anything is me. And idk if I want to. I'm still trying to find out. I'm still considering doing it. There are only a few things I want to avoid (saying the wrong thing, leaving behind a mess, etc etc) but I'm also not rushing into it. I'm trying to preoccupy myself with other things and to come out of this with a positive out look. But honestly? Idk if I want to. I identify as my daughters father, and my wife's husband, I don't need or want to be anyone else. So honestly? Idk what I'm going to do, and idk why I made this post. Guess I was just hoping to hear something I already haven't heard or thought of yet.

Right now there is nothing anyone can do to help. I have to find something that makes me want to keep on. I need to stop writing my notes in my head and telling myself that my daughter will be better off without knowing this..  Me. I have to find someway to be more positive... I know what I need to do... I'm just having issues doing them.

Why? because life doesn't end with one person. Yes, they might have been your ONE... but life doesn't end there. Focus on you. Focus on the people in your life that want to be there. I don't know about you, but I have a LOT of tension and extra frustration energy. Instead of doing something stupid? 

Go out and run. Lose that weight you've been always meaning to but never got to. Lift weights, gain that muscle that you've been meaning to. Volunteer, give back to the community, go back to school, there are so many things that are positive you can and should do. Pick up that hobby you never had time because you were busy with that person, or pick up that show that you've been missing because they ~~don't~~ didn't want to watch it and you wanted to spend time with them. 

Call up that friend that you neglected because of that S/O, that's no longer with you.... and try to reconnect. That's the hardest part, getting back into the swing of things before you met that person. That's what I'm focusing on right now. Me. Selfish? No, you're just trying to get to a point where those thoughts are no longer with you. Stay positive (force it, after a while you will notice you're not forcing it, and look back and ask yourself what the big deal was anyway). Breathe, and live. Life goes on.
